description: This script generates a FIT (Flattened Image Tree) source (.its) file for U-Boot firmware, incorporating kernel, device tree, initrd, root filesystem, and overlays based on user input options. It defines functions for usage and parameter validation, processes command line options, and constructs a complex configuration structure that is outputted as an ITS file.

methods.name: check_required_params
methods.description: Validates that all required parameters are provided before proceeding.
